get.summary: Read the authenticated GARANG user's current context

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked Firebase ID token

405.description: GET is the only allowed method

post.summary: Explain the authenticated user's server-computed GARANG decision with the configured LLM provider
post.description: The gateway derives Memory, State and Decision context from the Firebase-authenticated user's canonical state. Client-supplied context or user identifiers are not trusted. LLM action intent is advisory only and never writes user state.

200.description: Structured LLM explanation anchored to the GARANG decision

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked Firebase ID token

405.description: POST is the only allowed method

502.description: LLM timeout, provider error, or malformed response; client should use deterministic fallback

503.description: User data unavailable or LLM secret missing; client should use deterministic fallback

post.summary: Permanently delete the authenticated user's GARANG data and Firebase Auth account

401.description: Missing token or recent authentication required

405.description: POST is the only allowed method
